title: Projection naturality for insertion of a supported diagonal class
statement:
Let \(A\) be a finite commutative ring and \(f:X\to Y\) proper. Use all the canonical maps and notation of [def-sf-supported-diagonal-calculus]. Let \(B\in D_A(X)\), \(L\in D_A(Y)\), \(e:B\simeq f^*L\), and \(\delta:U\to p_2^*B\) any morphism. For all \(M\in D_A(X)\) and \(K\in D_A(Y)\),
\[F(I_\delta(M));D(E_B(M));F(\pi_{p_1,M,p_2^*B}^{-1})=F(\rho_M^{-1};(\mathrm{id}_M\otimes(\alpha_1(\mathbf1_X);P_1(\delta)))),\]
\[I_\delta(H_BK);P_2(c_H\otimes\mathrm{id}_{p_2^*B});\pi_{p_2,H_BK,p_2^*B}^{-1}=\rho_{H_BK}^{-1};(\mathrm{id}_{H_BK}\otimes(\alpha_2(\mathbf1_X);P_2(\delta))).\]
Here \(\rho\) is the canonical right unitor, \(\alpha_2\) is idIsoDiagonalSnd, and semicolons denote composition in application order. No trace, lisse-line condition, or integral normalization is assumed.

source.place: Projection naturality for insertion of a supported diagonal class; both coordinate triangle computations

proof.text: Expand insertion and use naturality of the canonical tensor symmetry to factor its component into α2(M), pushforward of the diagonal tensor-unit identification with factors swapped, and pushforward of identity tensor δ. Prove inverse ordered-projection naturality directly from naturality of projectionMap and of the two tensor swaps. These are private, fully proved categorical calculations.

For the first coordinate, use diagonalPushComparison to move α2 across directComparison. Naturality of directComparison moves the remaining diagonal-kernel map to the first coordinate. Apply properSectionProjectionUnit to Δ,p1, identifying its canonical section comparison with diagonalFirst and its tensor-unit factor with diagonalIso followed by swap. Cancel forward/inverse projection and apply inverse-projection naturality in δ. Functoriality gives exactly the first claimed equation.

For the second coordinate first prove that diagonalSectionIso(M) followed by Δ* of the common-base coordinate comparison is the inverse section comparison for p2. For M=f*N use the two associativity identities leftDerivedUpperStarComp_assoc'_app for Δ,p1,f and Δ,p2,f and cancel their common prefix; extend along any e:M≅f*N by naturality. Apply this with N=L tensor K and e=coefficientPull. Naturality of projectionUnitIso and tensor symmetry transports the diagonal tensor-unit identification to the second coordinate. Apply properSectionProjectionUnit to Δ,p2. Finally tensor naturality in δ commutes it with coordinateTwisted, and inverse ordered-projection naturality yields the second equation. All these coordinate and arbitrary-class calculations are complete Lean proofs in the item module.

lean.statement:
theorem insertion_projection {B : DerivedCategoryModule A X}
    (L : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (e : B ≅ (CoordinateTrace.pull A f).obj L)
    (δ : (push A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).obj
        (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ⟶
      (CoordinateTrace.pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj B) :
    (∀ M : DerivedCategoryModule A X,
      (push A f).map (insertionApp A f δ M) ≫
          (directComparison A f).hom.app (kernel A f B M) ≫
            (push A f).map
              (orderedProjection A (pullback.fst f f) M
                ((CoordinateTrace.pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj B)).inv =
        (push A f).map
          ((unitRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X M).inv ≫
            ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map
              ((SfDiagonalKernel.diagonalFirst A f).hom.app
                  (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
                (push A (pullback.fst f f)).map δ))) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y,
      insertionApp A f δ ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
        B).obj K) ≫
          (push A (pullback.snd f f)).map
            (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback f f)).map
              (coordinateTwisted A f L K e).hom).app
                ((CoordinateTrace.pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj B)) ≫
            (orderedProjection A (pullback.snd f f) ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B).obj K)
              ((CoordinateTrace.pull A (pullback.snd f f)).obj B)).inv =
        (unitRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X
            ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B).obj
              K)).inv ≫
          ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
              ((CoordinateTrace.pull A f ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj B).obj
                K)).map
            ((TraceDiagonalDatum.idIsoDiagonalSnd (Λ := A) f).hom.app
                (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
              (push A (pullback.snd f f)).map δ))
